coverage: Three offline federation readers in the patch. Other 1.5 import entry points use different contracts.
reader_identity: Matrix profile revision plus reader_source_sha256. At runtime the receipt carries logical source name and raw SHA-256; the envelope carries the projection format. No producer-version gate.

shared_semantics.identity: Canonical TCP literal-IP service and port. HTTP endpoints also bind scheme and path. No DNS, remote references or command execution.
shared_semantics.provenance: Observation.record = logical source name + '#' + locator. Each source receipt includes SHA-256 over every original input byte. Different bytes under the same profile are rejected within a preview. Identical inputs deduplicate; each submission consumes byte budget.
shared_semantics.omissions: One receipt disposition per recognized source unit. Unmapped producer fields and structures outside that unit have no per-field counter; original bytes are required to inspect them.
shared_semantics.bad_document: Validation error aborts the entire preview without a partial result.
shared_semantics.retention: Preview presents approved field subset and accepted paths. Retention binds service, typed fields, locator and source digest. HTTP paths, Nmap reason/name and Nuclei template/matcher become domain-separated digests. Original files stay with the operator. Hashes support checking source identity and are not encryption.
shared_semantics.http_target: Accepts canonical literal HTTP(S) authorities, allowed path grammar and default-port normalization. Query, userinfo, fragment, encoded path, sensitive-looking path segments and ambiguous paths are unsupported. Nonliteral hostname is unresolved. Literal service outside the whitelist is out_of_scope.

profiles.producer_format: Nmap XML nmaprun, selected TCP service observations
profiles.nulls: Optional reason/name/method/confidence may be null. Service method table or probed is kept as reported. Confidence 0..10 is manufacturer confidence.
omitted: host status, addresses other than IPv4/IPv6, hostnames
aggregated extraports, run statistics and timestamps
product, version, CPE, OS, scripts, arguments, XML stylesheets
profiles.source_units_without_rows: Hosts with no port elements, extraports, absent ports and non-port XML elements produce no record; absence does not establish closed ports.
profiles.classification: Each port with zero or multiple distinct host IPs is unresolved; otherwise non-TCP is unsupported. Open/closed/filtered and composite accepted states are source observations, not vulnerabilities.
atomic_rejections: root other than nmaprun or explicit foreign scanner
external/internal DTD subsets, entity declarations, non-UTF-8 or malformed XML
multiple ports containers, duplicate state or service declarations, unsupported port state/method/confidence, invalid declared IP family

profiles.producer_format: ffuf v2-style result-array JSON; limited file-export field subset
profiles.nulls: Missing length is null; zero is retained. Absent, null or empty config.method gives null. Accepted public method is copied verbatim.
omitted: input, position, words, lines, content-type, redirectlocation, duration, resultfile, scraper
profiles.source_units_without_rows: Empty results produces zero rows. Top-level metadata and custom producer fields do not count as observations.
profiles.classification: Unrecognized method or nonempty routing/credential context places each result in unsupported_request_context. Host inconsistency is unresolved. HTTP status alone creates no finding.
atomic_rejections: malformed/non-UTF-8 JSON, duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, exceeded depth
non-object document, non-array results, non-object row or config
for an admitted request context: missing/invalid status or present invalid length

profiles.producer_format: Nuclei v3-style HTTP ResultEvent JSONL; selected fields only

field_map.host/ip/port/scheme/url: optional consistent source identity; base path can differ

profiles.nulls: Missing or null matcher status remains unknown. False remains a negative source assertion. Both receive a null observation level and no finding. Only explicit true creates a hint; a template ID is required.
omitted: timestamp, metadata, extracted contents, template bodies/paths, arguments
CVE classification, tags, author, issue trackers, interaction, line references and extra fields
profiles.source_units_without_rows: Blank lines count toward the physical-line cap but create no receipt row. Other protocols create unsupported_protocol receipt rows.
profiles.classification: Nonempty request, response, curl-command or extracted-results gives unsupported_raw_record. Disagreeing optional origin fields give unresolved_scope. Positive records at the same endpoint share one hint group, each with its own source locator.
atomic_rejections: malformed/non-UTF-8 JSON, duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, exceeded depth or topology limits
invalid admitted HTTP info object, severity or matcher-status type, invalid identifiers or explicit true with missing template ID

published_reference.permission_status: No separate redistribution grant for the submitted example was verified. Reference and checksum only; optional checkout check uses the file already present.
published_reference.limitations: Host-only example, no service row. Native tool execution and provenance of the author's production run have not been independently witnessed.

missing: redistributable version-pinned native Nmap TCP service-port export
redistributable version-pinned native ffuf file export
redistributable version-pinned native Nuclei HTTP result export
native_compatibility_gate.closure: For each profile acquire an approved unmodified static export, producer version and origin, permissible redistribution/use, SHA-256, privacy review and expected per-field positive/negative results. Recheck through product readers and independent checker without starting a producer.
